body:
Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 100, 90, 20)

ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"

ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
box1.Delete
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

body:
Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
box1.Delete
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"

ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

End If
Next sh

End If
Next sh

End If
Next sh

Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 410, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 125, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio5"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 410, 150, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio6"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
box1.Delete
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"

sh.Name = "Radio3"

sh.Name = "Radio4"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 125, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio5"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 410, 150, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio6"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio4").ControlFormat.Value = 1
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 410, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 125, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio5"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 410, 150, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio6"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio5").ControlFormat.Value = 1
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

Set box2 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 200, 0, 150, 200)
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

body:
Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Set box2 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 200, 0, 150, 200)
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
box1.Delete
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

body:
Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Set box2 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 200, 0, 150, 200)
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
box2.Delete
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

sh.Name = "Radio3"

ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"

ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Set box2 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 200, 0, 150, 200)
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio4").ControlFormat.Value = 1
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Set box2 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 200, 0, 150, 200)
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

body:
Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Set box2 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 200, 0, 150, 200)
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
box1.Delete
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

body:
Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Set box2 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 200, 0, 150, 200)
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
box2.Delete
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Set box2 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 200, 0, 150, 200)
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"

ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio4").ControlFormat.Value = 1

Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes

End If
Next sh

body:
Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Set box2 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 200, 0, 150, 200)
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
box1.Delete
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

body:
Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Set box2 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 200, 0, 150, 200)
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
box2.Delete
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Set box2 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 200, 0, 150, 200)
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then

End If
Next sh

End If
Next sh

Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Set box2 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 200, 0, 150, 200)
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 410, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 125, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio5"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 410, 150, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio6"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

body:
Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Set box2 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 200, 0, 150, 200)
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 410, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 125, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio5"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 410, 150, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio6"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
box1.Delete
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Set box2 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 200, 0, 150, 200)
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 410, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 125, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio5"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 410, 150, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio6"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
box2.Delete
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh

End If
Next sh

body:
Range("H1:H2").ClearContents
Set box2 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 200, 0, 150, 200)
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 25, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio1"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 50, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio2"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 410, 75, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio3"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 10, 100, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio4"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 210, 125, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio5"
Set sh = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(7, 410, 150, 90, 20)
sh.Name = "Radio6"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$1"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.LinkedCell = "$H$2"
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio1").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio2").ControlFormat.Value = 1
ActiveSheet.Shapes("Radio5").ControlFormat.Value = 1
Set box1 = ActiveSheet.Shapes.AddFormControl(4, 0, 0, 150, 200)
Report = CStr(Range("H1").Value) & ":" & CStr(Range("H2").Value) & "|"
For Each sh In ActiveSheet.Shapes
If Left(sh.Name, 5) = "Radio" Then
Report = Report & sh.Name & ":" & CStr(sh.ControlFormat.Value) & ":" & sh.ControlFormat.LinkedCell & ";"
End If
Next sh
